description: What is this address on each chain: unused EOA, active EOA, EIP-7702-delegated EOA (with delegate), ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, Safe multisig (threshold, owners, version), or other contract; EIP-1967/beacon/zos/EIP-1167 proxy with implementation and admin; owner(); nonce, native balance and code size. From bytecode, storage slots and probe calls via free public RPCs. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/address-info.

chain.description: optional; comma-separated chains. Default: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc
